chapters.label: Marseille
chapters.text: Marseille, 1998, a World Cup quarter-final. The Netherlands, in orange, and Argentina are level at one-one in the last minute. Frank de Boer hits a long, long pass for Dennis Bergkamp. One, two, three... goal!

chapters.label: Three touches
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Touch one: his right foot cushions the ball dead. Touch two: inside Roberto Ayala. Touch three: the outside of his foot.

chapters.label: Far corner
chapters.text: Over the keeper, Carlos Roa, into the far corner. Two-one! The Netherlands are into the semi-final!

chapters.label: First touch
chapters.text: A perfect first touch kills the ball dead and sets up your next move.
